sourceAndPedagogicalAttention.source: In its first year, the newly opened Hansol Library had 40 percent more visitors than the previous year, and the city judged that citizens' reading culture had spread. Yet in the same period, books borrowed rose by only 3 percent. In a user survey, a majority said they came to study in the reading room. The number of visitors may be an indicator reflecting a facility's accessibility and comfort, but it does not directly represent the amount of reading. To speak of the spread of reading culture, other indicators such as the number of books borrowed or reading time must be presented together.

sourceAndPedagogicalAttention.source: At a translation conference, a presenter pointed out that the more culturally loaded a word in the source language is, the more the attempt to find and use its closest equivalent flattens the meaning. He acknowledged that the counterargument, that adding footnotes breaks the reader's immersion, has some merit. Even so, he said he wanted to make clear that a translation that is easy to read is not necessarily a translation faithful to the original. The conference decided to make this issue a formal debate topic at next year's meeting.

sourceAndPedagogicalAttention.source: In an opinion poll on a new-town development plan, 48 percent were in favor and 45 percent were opposed, and a broadcaster reported 'Pro-development opinion leads.' The sampling error of this poll is plus or minus 3.1 percentage points at the 95 percent confidence level. Because the 3-point difference between support and opposition lies within the margin of error, one cannot say statistically which side is larger. In such a case, writing 'opinion is evenly split' is an expression more faithful to the data. A report that carries the size of numbers directly over into a ranking is likely to read to readers like a settled fact.

canonical.ko: 신도시 개발 계획에 대한 여론조사에서 찬성 48%, 반대 45%가 나오자 한 방송사는 '찬성 여론 우세'라고 보도했다. 이 조사의 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에서 ±3.1%포인트이다. 찬성과 반대의 차이는 3%포인트로 오차 범위 안에 있으므로, 어느 쪽이 더 많은지 통계적으로 확언할 수 없다. 이런 경우에는 '찬반이 팽팽하다'고 쓰는 것이 자료에 더 충실한 표현이다. 숫자의 크기를 그대로 순위로 옮기는 보도는 독자에게 확정된 사실처럼 읽히기 쉽다.
canonical.g: In an opinion poll on a new-town development plan, 48 percent were in favor and 45 percent were opposed, and a broadcaster reported 'Pro-development opinion leads.' The sampling error of this poll is plus or minus 3.1 percentage points at the 95 percent confidence level. Because the 3-point difference between support and opposition lies within the margin of error, one cannot say statistically which side is larger. In such a case, writing 'opinion is evenly split' is an expression more faithful to the data. A report that carries the size of numbers directly over into a ranking is likely to read to readers like a settled fact.

sourceAndPedagogicalAttention.source: In weather articles, the expression 'highest temperature since records began' requires care in interpretation. For example, the Onsaemi observatory has recorded temperatures since 1998, so its 'since records began' is merely a ranking within a record of some twenty years. It cannot be placed side by side and compared with the records of other sites that have been observing for nearly a century. Moreover, if the surroundings of the observatory have urbanized and heat accumulates more easily, the causes of the temperature rise include changes in the local environment as well as climate change. Therefore this expression may be true, but that does not directly mean it is direct evidence of climate change.

sourceAndPedagogicalAttention.source: A: Opinions are split over whether the benchmark rate should be cut. Let us first hear from Dr. B. B: If rates are cut, the interest burden falls and consumption can revive. But household debt is high now, so the extra room is likely to go to paying off debt rather than to consumption. C: I understand that concern, but we cannot just watch the economy sink, can we? B: I am not opposed to a cut itself. I mean that if rates are cut without measures to manage debt, the expected effect may be halved.

B: I am not opposed to a cut itself. I mean that if rates are cut without measures to manage debt, the expected effect may be halved.

rd.t: B는 금리 인하를 반대하지 않지만, 부채를 관리하는 대책이 함께 없으면 인하의 효과가 줄어든다고 본다.
